description: Arrange multiple PDF pages onto single sheets in N-up layouts. Puts 2 or 4 source pages onto each output page side-by-side. Useful for printing handouts, saving paper, or creating thumbnail sheets.

layout.description: "2-up" = 2 pages per sheet side-by-side, "4-up" = 4 pages per sheet in a 2x2 grid

name: pdf_page_layout
